more_info.overview: Guaiac resin is the resin preparation also recorded as gum guaiac or guaiacum. JECFA identifies it as an antioxidant under INS 314. Its historical technological role is to slow oxidative deterioration in food. The retained evaluation is from 1973, so it describes an older preparation and assessment rather than demonstrating a current food-market application.
more_info.banned_in:
No current country-wide food-use ban was confirmed in the regulatory sources checked in 2026.
EU and US food-additive permissions for this exact entry were not confirmed in the sources checked in 2026.
